title: The Bernina Express
route: Brescia → Tirano → Bernina Pass → St. Moritz → Tirano → Brescia
intro: One of the signature experiences of The Long Way Around begins in Tirano, where the Bernina Express climbs from Italy into the Swiss Alps. The railway winds through Valposchiavo, crosses the famous Brusio Circular Viaduct, climbs past Alp Grüm to the Bernina Pass and Lago Bianco, and continues through Pontresina to St. Moritz. After reaching St. Moritz, the journey retraces the spectacular Bernina route back to Tirano before returning to Brescia.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Leave Brescia and drive north toward Tirano for the start of the rail journey.

stops.name: Tirano
stops.description: Board the Bernina Express in Tirano for the journey from Italy into the Swiss Alps.

stops.name: Brusio Circular Viaduct
stops.description: Cross the famous stone spiral viaduct where the Bernina Railway loops around itself to gain elevation.

stops.name: Poschiavo
stops.description: Continue through the Italian-speaking Valposchiavo as the railway climbs higher into the Alps.

stops.name: Alp Grüm
stops.description: Pass Alp Grüm for sweeping views across the Bernina Range and toward the Palü Glacier.

stops.name: Ospizio Bernina & Lago Bianco
stops.description: Reach the highest section of the Bernina Railway at 2,253 meters beside Lago Bianco and the Bernina Pass.

stops.name: Pontresina
stops.description: Descend into the Upper Engadin and pass through Pontresina on the approach to St. Moritz.

stops.name: St. Moritz
stops.description: Reach St. Moritz at the northern end of the Bernina journey before boarding the return trip.

stops.name: Tirano
stops.description: Return across the Bernina route to Tirano after the round-trip journey through the Alps.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Drive back to Brescia after a full day aboard the Bernina Express.
